==================
expressions: precedence and associativity
==================

fn main() {
    let a = 1 + 2 * 3 - 4 / 2 % 2
    let b = not true or false and true
    let c = 1 == 2 or 3 != 4
    let d = 0..10
    let e = 0..=10
    let f = None ?? Some(1) ?? Some(2)
}

==================
expressions: unary and postfix chains
==================

fn main() {
    let values = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
    let first = values[0][1]
    let maybe = Some(1)
    let value = maybe?
    let text = "abc".len()
    let pair = (1, 2)
    let one = pair.0
    let chained = values.map(fn(xs) => xs.len()).last()
}

==================
expressions: tuple list map and unit literals
==================

fn main() {
    let unit = ()
    let one = (1,)
    let tuple = (1, "two", true)
    let list = [1, 2, 3]
    let empty = []
    let table = {
        "a": 1,
        "b": 2,
    }
    let empty_table = {}
}

==================
expressions: struct literals shorthand and update
==================

struct Point { x: int, y: int }

fn main() {
    let x = 1
    let y = 2
    let p = Point { x, y }
    let moved = Point { ..p, x: 3 }
}

==================
expressions: if and else if
==================

fn classify(n: int) -> str {
    if n < 0 {
        "negative"
    } else if n == 0 {
        "zero"
    } else {
        "positive"
    }
}

==================
expressions: match guards and qualified variants
==================

enum Token { Number(int), Word(str), Empty }

fn score(token: Token) -> int {
    match token {
        Token.Number(value) if value > 0 => value,
        Number(value) => -value,
        Word(text) => text.len(),
        Empty => 0,
    }
}

==================
expressions: lambda forms
==================

fn main() {
    let double = fn(x) => x * 2
    let add = fn(a: int, b: int) -> int { a + b }
    let values = [1, 2, 3].map(double)
    print("{add(values[0], values[1])}")
}

==================
expressions: parenthesized struct literal in a control-flow head
==================

struct Point { x: int }

fn main() {
    if (Point { x: 1 }).x == 1 { print("x") }
}

struct Point { x: int }

==================
expressions: unparenthesized map arm is a block
==================

fn choose() -> int {
    match 1 {
        _ => {"a": 1},
    }
}
